id_and_class.summary: Alfredo Pereira Jr. proposes that brain activity has three inseparable aspects of a single substance: physiological, mental-unconscious and mental-conscious. Consciousness co-emerges from them when large waves in the astrocyte network integrate information carried by neuronal signals and instantiate feelings, which then feed back to shape cognition and behavior.
id_and_class.core_identity_tagline: Consciousness as Feeling Co-Emerging From Three Aspects

conceptual_ground.explanatory_identity_claim: Consciousness is the mental-conscious aspect of brain activity: first-person experience of feelings, qualia, attention, memory, voluntary action and evaluation, co-emerging with physiological and mental-unconscious aspects of one substance.
conceptual_ground.mind_body_relationship: Mind, brain and world form one system. The physiological and the two mental aspects are inseparable aspects of a single substance, so conscious experience arises from physical processes without dualism.
conceptual_ground.emergence_type: Co-emergence (consciousness arises together with, and inseparably from, the physiological and mental-unconscious aspects)
conceptual_ground.subjectivity_and_intentionality: The first-person perspective belongs to the third, conscious aspect. Pereira describes the self as a ‘Feeling Self’ that is empty of essence and constituted by the dynamics of experience.
conceptual_ground.qualia_account: Feelings and qualia are instantiated by large waves in the astrocyte network that integrate distributed information from neurons. Each feeling has a valence that determines how it modulates neural activity.
conceptual_ground.ontological_commitments: A single substance with three aspects; neuronal and biochemical processes; glial-astrocyte networks; electromagnetic microstates of brain networks; informational patterns such as brain-wave frequencies and synaptic network patterns.
conceptual_ground.epistemic_access: The physiological aspect is studied by neuroscience, the unconscious aspect through informational patterns in neural activity, and the conscious aspect through first-person experience.
conceptual_ground.constituents_and_structure: Aspect 1: physiological processes involving matter and energy. Aspect 2: unconscious informational patterns that are transmitted, stored, combined, matched, amplified and erased. Aspect 3: conscious experience and the cognitive functions grounded in it.

mechanism_and_dynamics.scope_of_consciousness: Phenomenal feeling, attention, memory, voluntary action, aesthetic and ethical evaluation, and the self.
mechanism_and_dynamics.distinctive_mechanism_or_principle: Dendritic potentials generate amplitude-modulated waves that pass into the extracellular medium and adjacent astrocytes, triggering large astrocyte waves that integrate information and instantiate feelings.
mechanism_and_dynamics.dynamics_of_emergence: A loop: neuronal activity drives astrocyte waves, and the resulting feeling feeds back on synapses, reinforcing or depressing cognitive and behavioral functions according to its valence.
mechanism_and_dynamics.location_and_distribution: Distributed across neuronal networks, the glial-astrocyte network and electromagnetic microstates of brain networks.
mechanism_and_dynamics.causation_and_functional_role: Feelings are causally active. Their valence modulates synapses and so shapes cognition and behavior.
mechanism_and_dynamics.integration_or_binding: Large waves in the astrocyte network integrate information that is spatially distributed across neurons.
mechanism_and_dynamics.information_flow_or_representation: Unconscious processing consists of dynamic informational patterns (wave frequencies, amplitudes, phase-modulated waves and synaptic patterns) embodied in neural activity, which become conscious when integrated by astrocyte waves.
core_claims_and_evidence: Pereira adds a distinct mental-unconscious aspect between physiological processes and conscious awareness.
Astrocyte waves integrate distributed neuronal information and instantiate feelings.
The valence of a feeling feeds back on neuronal synapses and modulates cognition and behavior.
The Feeling Self forms from habits over a person's life history and is anchored in attention, learning and memory.
mechanism_and_dynamics.basis_of_belief_or_evidence_type: Philosophical model informed by neuroscience of neurons, glia and brain electromagnetic activity.

empirics_and_critiques.ontological_coherence: The single substance with three aspects places the view among aspect monisms, yet it also calls consciousness emergent from physical processes, which leaves open whether the physiological aspect has priority.

AI_consciousness.rationale: Since feelings are instantiated by astrocyte waves integrating neuronal signals, systems lacking this biological machinery would not have them.

survival_beyond_death.rationale: Since consciousness co-emerges with physiological brain processes, it does not outlast the brain.

meaning_and_purpose.rationale: Pereira draws on Nāgārjuna's co-origination and interdependence to say the conscious self is integrated in the whole of reality, without claiming a cosmic purpose.

virtual_immortality.rationale: The Feeling Self depends on biological astrocyte and neuronal dynamics, which a simulation would not reproduce physically.

related_theories.name: Nāgārjuna’s Empty Consciousness: Experience Without Essence
